profile.name: Awki awki
profile.tagline: A Bolivian-Peruvian folk dance satirizing elderly Spanish colonial conquerors.
profile.insight: In Awki awki, men don masks with long white beards and large woven straw hats to satirize the elderly Spanish conquerors of the colonial period.
profile.profile: Awki awki is a folk dance performed in the La Paz Department of Bolivia and the Huancané Province of Peru. Derived from the Aymara word auqui, meaning father or old man with a reduplication indicating a collective noun, the dance satirizes elderly Spanish conquerors of the colonial period. Performers wear formal colonial suits, large woven straw hats, and masks with long white beards.
profile.profile_long: Awki awki, also known as Auqui Auqui, is a traditional folk dance documented in the La Paz Department of Bolivia and the Huancané Province of Peru. The name originates from the Aymara word auqui, which translates to father or old man. The term features a reduplication that forms a collective noun, indicating a group of such figures. Culturally and historically, the dance serves as a form of satire directed at the elderly Spanish conquerors of the colonial period. In terms of performance and attire, the dance is executed exclusively by men. Participants wear distinct costumes that represent formal colonial-era suits. Their physical presentation is enhanced by large hats made of woven straw and detailed masks that depict elderly men characterized by long white beards. Beyond these core descriptive elements derived from foundational records, detailed accounts regarding specific choreography, musical accompaniment, footwork patterns, instrumentation, and performance occasions remain largely unrecorded in current documentation.

sections.origins_and_history: Awki awki is rooted in the Aymara language and culture, deriving its name from auqui, meaning father or old man, with a reduplication indicating a collective noun. Historically, the dance functions as a theatrical satire targeting the elderly Spanish conquerors of the colonial period in the Andean region.
